_comment: Season of a visit from its UTC month (1-12) and methodology version (docs/metodoloji.md, section 2). Shared by apps/web (src/lib/expert/season.ts), services/ai-worker (methodology.py) and apps/field (lib/features/tasks/field_task.dart): each runs every case in its tests.
